results.name: RAFAEL LITENING
results.description:
LITENING is the world’s most widely-used, combat-proven targeting and navigation pod. It incorporates a wide array of sensors enabling target detection, recognition, and identification. Known for its ability to shorten the sensor-to-shooter cycle, LITENING-5 provides electro-optical tracking of multiple stationary and dynamic targets. Its open architecture and vacant internal space enable integration of numerous capabilities and growth potential, such as SAR, ELINT, and more. LITENING’s advanced operational capabilities enhance the fighter’s mission and effectiveness of the combat range through all types of smart air-to-surface weaponry including laser-guided, GPS-guided, and EO/IR imaging-guided munitions.

Here is the details page：https://www.military.co.il/system/litening/

**Some parts of this model are a version that I have improved according to my own needs. The number of triangles is relatively low, which is suitable for game scenes but not suitable for film**

results.name: SKYWATCHER - Beam - 3D Revisualization
results.description:
A recreation of the 2D visual representations found on the SKYWATCHER website, so you can view their represented forms interactive 3D.

**NOTE:** These are just recreations of the icons present in those UAP visuals and don't necessarily reflect the true design of the UAP as they have taken an approach of artistic leniency and interpretation of their sightings.

**Full Information**
https://skywatcher.ai/research/beam

**Related Video To This Specific UAP**
https://youtu.be/JUthXIGUsq8

**Description:**
IR-only orb-shaped UAP that vibrates while in a stable flight path. Hovers in place for hours at a time. Seen in pairs.

**Visual Profile:**
Not visible in EO spectrum; only observable on IR. Presents as a stable, orb-shaped UAP with a strong heat signature and no off-gassing or visible propulsion.

**Size:**
Unknown

**Flight Behavior:**
Refer to above link for additional informaiton on this part.

results.name: SKYWATCHER - Jellyfish - 3D Revisualization
results.description:
A recreation of the 2D visual representations found on the SKYWATCHER website, so you can view their represented forms interactive 3D.

**NOTE:** These are just recreations of the icons present in those UAP visuals and don't necessarily reflect the true design of the UAP as they have taken an approach of artistic leniency and interpretation of their sightings.

**Full Information**
https://skywatcher.ai/research/jellyfish

**Related Video To This Specific UAP**
https://youtu.be/JUthXIGUsq8

**Description:**
Jellyfish-shaped UAP with "seeking" head motion and trailing tentacles. Exhibits a localized area effect on electronics, independent of specific targeting or interaction with sensors.

**Visual Profile:**
White, jellyfish-shaped craft with a bulbous head and trailing tentacle-like appendages. The head comprises roughly 1/5 of the overall length, while the tail extends downward and appears to move independently of wind conditions. Observable on both EO and IR.

**Size:**
2 m (head), 3 - 5 m (tentacles)

results.name: Votivinschrift, Zollfeld/Maria Saal
results.description: **Inschrift/Inscription:** D(eo) I(nvicto) M(ithrae) templum vetusta(te) / conlabsum(!) quot(!) fuit / per annos amplius / L desertum Aur(elius) / Hermodorus v(ir) p(erfectissimus) p(raeses) p(rovinciae) N(orici) / m(edi)t(erranei) a novo restitui fecit / quot(!) (a)edificatum est divo / Maximiano VIII et Maximino it(e)r(um) / A(u)gg(ustis) con(sulibus) Quar(tinio) Ursiniano cur(ante), **Übersetzung/Translation:** Dem unbesiegten Gott Mithras ließ Aurelius Hermodurus, Statthalter von Binnenoricum, den verfallenen Tempel, der durch mehr als 50 Jahre verlassen war, erneuern. Unter der Leitung des Quartinius Ursinianus wurde dieser Bau hergestellt, als die beiden Kaiser, der nunmehr verewigte Maximian zum 8. Male und Maximinus zum 2. Male Konsuln waren.
